topics.label: Lecture framing: cancer hallmarks and their genetic basis
topics.groupedBecause: This opening establishes the lecture’s aims, its relationship to earlier lectures and the framework used to connect mutations with cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Deregulated growth and survival signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how mutations in extracellular signaling pathways make cancer cells proliferate and survive without normal regulatory control.

topics.label: Differentiation blocks and cancer cell identity
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how the differentiation state of cancer cells reveals disrupted tissue maturation and the cellular origins of tumors.

topics.label: Resistance to apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains how cancer-associated changes disrupt the mitochondrial machinery that commits damaged cells to death.

topics.label: Telomere maintenance and replicative immortality
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how telomere shortening limits normal cell division and how increased telomerase expression allows cancer cells to overcome that limit.

topics.label: p53-mediated genome protection and growth-control safeguards
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the protective growth-control responses coordinated by p53 and conclude by reviewing how mutations undermine normal growth control.

topics.label: Metabolic rewiring in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how altered metabolism supports cancer and can participate in self-reinforcing changes to gene regulation.

topics.label: Tumor angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains how tumors recruit a vascular supply that enables growth beyond the limits of oxygen and nutrient diffusion.

topics.label: Metastatic dissemination and successful colonization
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics investigate how cancer cells reach distant tissues and what determines whether they establish detectable metastases.

topics.label: Closing synthesis and further reading
topics.groupedBecause: This closing returns to the lecture’s overall learning goals, recommends further reading and invites questions before the practicals.
